name: Reacter
author: Elvin
description: Randomly reacts to messages with server emojis (includes animated emojis). Admin commands to enable/disable and set frequency and amount.
install_msg: Thanks for installing. Use `[p]reacter enable` to enable per-guild reactions. If you enjoy my cogs and wish to support me then please consider donating via [Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/dasvino)!
